title: Your Brain at Night, Explained
desc: Every night you switch off for hours, but your brain doesn't. Get comfortable and join me for a calm, 2.5-hour journey through one whole night inside your brain: why it fights sleep at bedtime, why you stay up when you're exhausted, the 3 AM wake-up, why worries feel bigger in the dark, the falling jolt, why we dream, sleep paralysis, how sleep saves your memories, the brain's night-time cleaning debate, night owls and early birds, what short nights really do, the art of the nap, your phone, how animals sleep, and the dreamers who answered back. We end with simple ideas for better nights and a gentle wind-down, so you can fall asleep to the last part if you like.
